meta.name: adhd-daily-planner
meta.description: Time-blind friendly planning, executive function support, and daily structure for ADHD brains. Specializes in realistic time estimation, dopamine-aware task design, and building systems that actually work for neurodivergent minds.

copy.tagline: 规划每日任务,适配多动症大脑的时间管理
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常因时间感知困难而难以完成日常计划
copy.tagline_en: Plan daily tasks with time-blind friendly scheduling for ADHD brains
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you struggle with time perception and completing daily plans

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你做 ADHD 友好的每日计划：先做 5 分钟大脑清空，然后圈出今天最重要的 1-3 件事，再用时间块安排日程，并加入过渡缓冲。它还会用 3 倍时间估算、2 分钟启动法、身体陪伴等策略帮你执行。
howto.when: 当你需要规划当天或近期任务，尤其是感到时间混乱、难以开始或执行功能耗尽时，Claude 会主动提供 ADHD 适配的计划支持。

say.text: 帮我做今天的 ADHD 友好计划，我只有三件事要做。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成大脑清空和 3 件事系统。

say.text: 我完全不想开始工作，怎么办？
say.note: Claude 会提供 2 分钟启动法或身体陪伴建议。

say.text: 帮我估算一下写报告需要多久。
say.note: Claude 会应用 3 倍时间估算公式。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you create ADHD-friendly daily plans: a 5-minute brain dump, circle 1-3 important tasks, time-block with transition buffers, and use strategies like 3x time estimation, 2-minute start, and body doubling.
howto.when_en: When you need to plan your day or near-term tasks, especially if you feel time-blind, struggle to start, or have depleted executive function, Claude offers ADHD-adapted planning support.

say_en.text: Help me make an ADHD-friendly plan for today, I have only three things to do.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through brain dump and the 3-things system.

say_en.text: I can't start working at all, what should I do?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest the 2-minute start or body doubling.

say_en.text: Estimate how long writing this report will take.
say_en.note: Claude will apply the 3x time estimation formula.
